source_facts.10624965: Human Caspr2 was cloned, while endogenous rat brain localization and biochemical assays showed juxtaparanodal enrichment and Kv1.2/Kvβ2-associated complexes. Reconstitution with only the tested channel subunits did not yield a stable complex, and occasional outermost glial paranodal loops were labeled.
source_facts.11352571: The paper defines the large human CNTNAP2 genomic locus and its predicted Caspr2 protein architecture. The available abstract does not establish an experimentally performed nerve-impulse transmission step.
source_facts.18179893: Human association and fetal-expression analyses relate CNTNAP2 to autism/language context. Regional fetal RNA distribution, childhood first-word measures and reported recessive regression do not separately demonstrate regional developmental participation or adult behavior.
source_facts.18179895: Mouse limbic and human temporal-cortex expression are distinct observations. Rat P9 brain fractionation supports a synaptic plasma-membrane pool, while human variant association remains limited by segregation and population context.
source_facts.18987363: FOXP2 binds and regulates CNTNAP2 in human neuronal cells; fetal cortical expression and language-associated variation connect the genes biologically. The assayed DNA-regulatory step is performed by FOXP2, not evidence by itself of CNTNAP2-driven cortical development.
source_facts.19166515: The complete abstract reports Caspr2–carboxypeptidase E association by two-hybrid, GST pull-down and co-immunoprecipitation, with neuronal and transfected-cell colocalization. These data support positive protease binding without establishing catalytic regulation.
source_facts.19706678: Human HA-tagged Caspr2 in rat hippocampal neurons reaches the axonal surface through selective somatodendritic endocytosis. Tail and motif manipulations, surface labeling and early-endosomal observations distinguish trafficking pools from polarized surface residence.
source_facts.19896112: Human biallelic CNTNAP2 defects cause severe neurodevelopmental disease with speech impairment and variable autistic features. Separate Drosophila neurexin-IV experiments concern synaptic organization; speech loss in patients is not an imitation-learning assay.
source_facts.25416956: HI-II-14 provides positive human CNTNAP2–MEOX2 pair records with validated, array and pooling two-hybrid evidence. General orthogonal validation of the map is not claimed as an additional exact-pair assay.
source_facts.26721881: Human CASPR2 ectodomain binds CNTN1 directly in biolayer interferometry and in cell-surface assays. Purified contactin-family comparisons were negative for other tested contactins under those conditions, which does not erase positive CNTN2 results obtained with different presentations.
source_facts.29028946: Mouse Cntnap2 loss and human CNTNAP2 rescue alter PV expression and interneuron maturation/physiology. MGE proliferation and survival were reported unchanged, and fate-mapped interneuron numbers were normal.
source_facts.32296183: HuRI supports the positive CNTNAP2–POLR2G and CNTNAP2–GORASP2 pairs. The screen records do not themselves locate an interface or demonstrate a native transcriptional or Golgi function for CNTNAP2.
source_facts.33238150: Human CNTNAP2 transgenes rescue junction morphology and locomotion in nlr-1-deficient worms and restore Cx43-based junction assembly. The direct actin-binding experiments are on worm NLR-1 and are not relabeled as human CNTNAP2 biochemical measurements.
source_facts.36115835: Quantitative holdup assays directly test the human CNTNAP2 terminal peptide against isolated human PDZ domains. Positive records define the binding class without establishing all full-length cellular complexes or their physiological importance.
source_facts.12963709: Mouse Caspr2 loss redistributes juxtaparanodal Kv1 channels without lowering total Kv1.2. Rat brain and transfected-cell association with TAG-1 supports a structural complex; the experiments do not completely distinguish initial recruitment from maintenance.
source_facts.26217189: Human Caspr2-Fc and TAG-1 constructs support presentation-dependent binding in transfected cells and rodent neurons. Endogenous rat neuronal labeling identifies presynaptic and glutamatergic/GABAergic sites, with effects on inhibitory contacts.
source_facts.19109503: The complete abstract reports that the Caspr2 cytoplasmic region is required for juxtaparanodal organization, whereas removal of the terminal PDZ-binding sequence still permits rescue. PSD93/PSD95 loss does not abolish the Caspr2–Kv1 complex.
source_facts.25378149: Mouse Caspr/Caspr2 double-mutant experiments support axonal domain organization. The abstract explicitly reports Caspr2 at paranodes in Caspr-deficient nerves, without restoration of a distinct paranodal junction.
source_facts.30126973: Cntnap2-deficient rats show altered acoustic startle and progressively impaired prepulse inhibition, accompanied by auditory timing changes. These support organismal circuit context rather than an independent molecular activity.
source_facts.19458237: Mouse DRG antibody and genetic-context experiments support Caspr2 participation in CD24-dependent neurite responses. The source uses Caspr1 knockout and explicitly lacks Caspr2-null neurons; these experiments are not renamed Caspr2 knockouts.
